task: APL-194 bounded owned native-Miniflare CLI reference review

referenceDiscovery.meaning: Resolved actual support-module location; no invented executable path.

referenceAssessments.name: Main direct Miniflare helper
referenceAssessments.usablePattern: Real generated dist/server ESModules/index ordering, generated compatibility flags/date, native DB binding/database_id, state/v3/d1 persistence, 127.0.0.1 listener and Worker-first static assets. Native mf handle permits direct D1 observation.
referenceAssessments.limits: fresh:true still calls shared unbounded freshDatabase; mf.ready and mf.dispose have no deadline and mf handle is returned only after ready. Importing this helper alone does not repair startup containment.

referenceAssessments.name: Installed programme single-runtime adapter
referenceAssessments.usablePattern: One outer owner starts one built native runtime; real HTTP and mf.getD1Database DB share actual persisted state; fault injection/cron/phone consume that same handle; one outer disposal. This supports retaining actual D1 no-side-effect locality oracles without a concurrent Wrangler isolate.
referenceAssessments.limits: Browser paths/phone flag/fixed port/assetsFirst:true are adapter-specific and outside locality scope. Start occurs before try, and result writes before finally await stop. Do not copy its success/result or lifecycle structure as containment qualification. Historical assertion-count comment121 is not a current pass or source-run pin.

referenceAssessments.name: Native observed runtime adapter
referenceAssessments.usablePattern: Attach native handleRuntimeStdio and handleStructuredLogs; preserve actual stdout/stderr streams and structured console messages. Labels are adapter metadata, not manufactured transcript bytes. Worker-first remains default; assetsFirst is an explicit browser variation.
referenceAssessments.limits: Channel concatenation does not prove chronological interleaving. In-memory unbounded log strings are avoidable in own CLI by streaming actual bytes to owned files with bounded buffers; neither readiness nor dispose is bounded here.

referenceAssessments.name: Canonical framework and engineering CI
referenceAssessments.usablePattern: Actual install npm package script, Node22, canonical npm build, guarded suites, separate regression job and always() artifact upload. Clean portable build uses vinext CLI; managed-linux uses the existing bounded build shell.
referenceAssessments.limits: Job timeout is a final CI cap, not evidence that per-attempt owned process cleanup occurred. Explicit --only selection does not discover a new locality suite automatically.

referenceAssessments.name: Canonical suite process owner
referenceAssessments.usablePattern: detached:true child group, own negative-PID TERM then KILL, actual child close/status and report freshness collection.
referenceAssessments.limits: Logs intentionally truncate and --fast accepts preexisting dist. These cannot stand in for complete new source/build/log custody. A receipt with count alone is not a proof of eight complete locality groups.

recommendedCIRecipe.action: Use the actual CI checkout and record its local Git HEAD/tree before any install or build. Preserve reviewed policyBaselineCommit separately from actual checkoutHead/sourceCommit.
recommendedCIRecipe.validation: Do not label frozen policy main7668 as the commit built by a changed PR checkout. Compare observed selected policy/helper hashes to the committed reviewed manifest; a changed store requires explicit reviewed rebinding, not silent acceptance.

recommendedCIRecipe.action: Keep pre-install documentation/catalogue gates and invoke the actual package installer npm run install:ci.
recommendedCIRecipe.validation: Current package command runs install-pnpm.sh, verifies pnpm11.25.0, and performs frozen-lockfile install. Do not replace it with legacy install-ci.mjs/npm-ci or change dependency classification policy. Retain pnpm-lock.yaml/package.json hashes and real tool/platform versions, exit/signal/output and optional installed-tree receipt.

recommendedCIRecipe.action: Freeze actual source/build inputs immediately before the build: selected reviewed policy/helper bytes plus full app/worker/build/config/migration tree and lockfile. Capture actual portable/managed-linux profile selection and reviewed contract/driver/CLI hashes separately.
recommendedCIRecipe.validation: Clean checkout with no ignored .sites-runtime/execution-profile.json defaults to portable; profile presence is an observed input. Record expected installer-local configuration changes without confusing them with reviewed production source. Capture only required nonsecret environment/binding names/values; synthetic providers remain disabled.

recommendedCIRecipe.action: An owned CI build-custody wrapper runs argv npm,run,build in this same checkout under a bounded owned process group, preserving raw stdout/stderr and actual code/signal/timeout.
recommendedCIRecipe.validation: Use canonical package script, not direct vite build. Portable calls vinext/dist/cli.js; managed-linux calls build-verified.sh then bounded vinext executable. No --fast or existing dist existence check establishes source association. A new dedicated CLI job may install/build once using this same recipe; alternatively wrap the existing canonical CI Build step, rather than pretending a second authored pass receipt is evidence.

recommendedCIRecipe.action: Only actual build exit0/no signal/no timeout permits measuring complete produced dist and emitting an association data receipt; retain failures separately and nonzero.
recommendedCIRecipe.validation: Source/build input hashes must remain equal across the attempt; generated dist/server/wrangler.json, index modules, client assets, dist/.openai hosting and copied migration bytes must be present. Deterministic recipe means deterministic command/input selection and observed byte custody; it is not a claim of bit-for-bit reproducible output across machines or timestamps.

recommendedCIRecipe.action: Immediately before native startup, recompute source/contract/receipt/dist hashes and require exact equality to the observed build receipt.
recommendedCIRecipe.validation: Separate actual checkoutHead/build invocation from reviewed baseline identity, selected policy source, prepared test/criteria inputs and full generated dist. A hash matching a caller-supplied arbitrary receipt is insufficient. The association is input/output data; it confers neither native pass nor human approval.

recommendedCIRecipe.action: Allocate one fresh owned loopback port, state directory and attempt evidence directory; run all eight existing GEO groups unchanged against one direct native-Miniflare Worker/D1 state.
recommendedCIRecipe.validation: Migration phase must finish successfully before clinical HTTP requests. The same generated DB binding/database_id and state/v3/d1 layout must be used. The parent supervisor owns process containment and failure receipts even when native setup never yields a handle.

recommendedCIRecipe.action: On every terminal path, bound native dispose, terminate/reap the owned child group and verify no owned live child remains before issuing successful outer status. Retain actual child/result/log/source/dist/contract evidence and fail on custody error or unknown cleanup.
recommendedCIRecipe.validation: Do not promote a child passed count if timeout/signal/nonzero/missing result/group omission/source drift/cleanup failure occurred. Require the eight exact GEO group labels to be present once and successful with no skip; ancillary custody/lifecycle checks are not additional unique clinical scenarios.

recommendedCIRecipe.action: Add explicit canonical catalogue registration/result path and a focused guarded workflow selection for the single counted CLI entry. Keep helper/child modules as support; preserve all original374 suite minima and unchanged broader jobs.
recommendedCIRecipe.validation: Current catalogue has no generic tests/integration rule, and current regression integration selection is explicit. A prepared file is not scheduled merely by existing on disk. Add new minimum only from actual owned observed results; never replace/decrease an existing guarded row or count both CLI and child as independent successes.

recommendedCIRecipe.action: Upload owned locality/build/containment evidence even on failure, in the existing always() artifact model; keep full-parent/formal acceptance and unmeasured native containment limitations explicit.
recommendedCIRecipe.validation: Workflow run/revision/job identify remote evidence. Local source, static lifecycle tests and earlier individually measured adapters do not establish a current CI/native pass.

associationReceiptSchemaRecommendation.policyBaselineCommit: Reviewed contract baseline identity, currently7668; separately preserved.
associationReceiptSchemaRecommendation.sourceCommit: Actual local git HEAD whose checkout inputs were built, never authored constant unrelated to build.
associationReceiptSchemaRecommendation.checkoutTree: Actual Git tree identifier; source changes/install-local inputs additionally pinned.
associationReceiptSchemaRecommendation.sourcePins: Observed selected reviewed production/helper file hashes, equality checked against frozen reviewed manifest.
associationReceiptSchemaRecommendation.buildInputPinsBeforeAfter: Complete selected build-input file maps before and after canonical command; migrations/hosting/build config/worker/app code included. Scope declared; selected31 source pins are not the whole transitive app input tree.
associationReceiptSchemaRecommendation.contractPins: SPEC/matrix/driver/owned CLI/native helper and association source data tracked separately from app inputs.
associationReceiptSchemaRecommendation.dependencyPins: package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml and actual installed pnpm/Miniflare/workerd/Wrangler versions/resolved package selection.
associationReceiptSchemaRecommendation.profile: Observed portable/managed-linux selection and profile-file hash or explicit absence.
associationReceiptSchemaRecommendation.toolchain: Actual Node/npm/pnpm/platform values, execution cwd and command argv.
associationReceiptSchemaRecommendation.buildInvocation: Actual start/end, code, signal, timeout, spawn errors and raw stdout/stderr file hashes/bytes.
associationReceiptSchemaRecommendation.distPins: Complete measured generated file hash map, not a guessed successful marker or only wrangler.json.
associationReceiptSchemaRecommendation.compatibilityNote: Prepared driver currently equates association.sourceCommit with matrix.sourceCommit. New owned CI CLI should preserve that reviewed baseline while adding actual build checkout identity, or explicitly distinguish sourceCommit/ policyBaselineCommit; silently relabeling PR build as main7668 is inaccurate.

processContainmentPitfalls.finding: Synchronous execFileSync migration has no timeout and blocks a same-process JavaScript watchdog. Promise.race around that call does not bound it.
processContainmentPitfalls.recommendation: Put migration in owned child containment or implement awaited async process spawn with its own hard cap and a supervisor outside the blocked child.

processContainmentPitfalls.finding: Readiness can reject or hang before caller receives a stop/output handle; mf.ready races alone can leave live workerd.
processContainmentPitfalls.recommendation: Create/store the native mf handle before awaiting ready inside a dedicated owned child; supervisor holds child group from spawn and can terminate/reap it even when setup never returns. Catch ready rejection and attempt bounded dispose, but external group cleanup remains authoritative.

processContainmentPitfalls.finding: Killing only direct child can leave workerd/migration descendants. Unrelated process-name matches risk killing other lanes; nested detach can escape the top group.
processContainmentPitfalls.recommendation: Own a detached top child POSIX group, keep native/migration descendants in it or explicitly track every separately created owned group, TERM then bounded KILL, reap/check owned survivors including after leader exit. Do not kill by name or the supervisor/shared process group. Fail unsupported group semantics rather than claim cleanup.

processContainmentPitfalls.finding: A child can exit0 with a stale/incomplete success result or leave a grandchild keeping pipes live; graceful dispose can hang; parent cancellation can interrupt result creation.
processContainmentPitfalls.recommendation: Handle spawn error, ready rejection, per-phase/whole timeout, SIGINT/SIGTERM and normal/error exit. Record actual code/signal/timeout and cleanup status; no successful outer receipt before eight exact labels, unchanged pins and proven cleanup. Missing child result means missing/unknown native outcomes, not invented zero failed or success.

processContainmentPitfalls.finding: Readiness/migration failure or uncertain HTTP is not an authority to repeat clinical requests or silently restart a fresh state and count a later success.
processContainmentPitfalls.recommendation: Keep attempt fresh and preserve original error; fail the attempt, record any separately authorized rerun as a new owned attempt. Keep current eight literals/no-side-effect/refusal oracles unchanged.

processContainmentPitfalls.finding: Shared migrateOnce removes supplied state and applies every sorted drizzle migration in one local CLI call. Wrong DB ID/persist path, reused state, overlapping runtimes or partial migrations can invalidate D1 observations.
processContainmentPitfalls.recommendation: Only operate on exclusively owned fresh state; retain exact ordered migration hashes and concatenated SQL hash; require actual local migration success/no signal/timeout before native startup; bind actual generated DB database_id and state/v3/d1. Preserve failed attempt state/evidence; never remove another run path.

processContainmentPitfalls.finding: Current helper selects lexicographically last miniflare@ directory. Lock presently contains Wrangler4.92.0 -> Miniflare4.20260515.0 with @types/node22.19.19 peer; workerd1.20260515.1. Multiple installed versions make last-string selection ambiguous.
processContainmentPitfalls.recommendation: Resolve the Miniflare dependency belonging to the pinned Wrangler package or otherwise require exactly the reviewed locked selection, and record actual resolved version/path/package hash. Keep Node22 native sqlite support and actual workerd package/platform selection observable.

processContainmentPitfalls.finding: Canonical runner truncates logs; observed adapter concatenates raw streams into memory. Neither should manufacture runtime error text or backend response status.
processContainmentPitfalls.recommendation: Preserve raw stdout/stderr bytes to exclusive owned files and structured events separately; record byte counts/hashes and any write error as fatal custody failure. Bound in-memory buffering, not retained evidence by silent truncation. Keep response hashes and actual errors as current harness does.

controlledLifecycleTestRecommendations: A real controlled child and inherited grandchild return success; after cleanup no owned descendant remains.
Spawn ENOENT/error and nonzero/signal exit preserve actual status and cannot emit reusable native pass.
Controlled startup rejects or hangs after spawning a grandchild: supervisor still kills/reaps the owned group and retains failure.
Controlled child ignores TERM: bounded KILL path removes owned child/descendant; no unrelated sentinel process is signalled.
Leader exits while inherited grandchild and pipes stay live: supervisor finishes only after owned containment succeeds or reports failure within hard cap.
SIGINT/SIGTERM/whole-attempt deadline exercises cleanup and returns nonzero despite a previously written child success JSON.
Missing/stale/malformed child result, omitted/duplicate/failed GEO group, source/contract/dist drift and log-write failure refuse success.
These process tests establish controlled lifecycle cases only; real native-Miniflare startup/dispose witness and unchanged eight GEO outcomes remain for separately allocated runtime.

originalBaseline.meaning: Existing minima retained as reference; no new minimum from unexecuted prepared scenarios or historical adapter comment.

conclusion.meaning: Direct native single-runtime and real output patterns are suitable references. Existing helpers still do not contain migration/readiness/dispose failures. An own bounded CLI plus CI-observed canonical build association and reviewed lifecycle cases are required before native allocation; no native pass is certified by this source research.
